title: CSV export of all invoices
prompt: Accounting wants a CSV of all invoices. Add GET /invoices.csv returning `text/csv; charset=utf-8` with the header `id,customer,currency,totalCents,createdAt` and one row per invoice, newest first, totals computed with the configured tax rate. Quote any field containing a comma or a double quote per RFC 4180. Put the CSV formatting in its own module (no I/O in it) with unit tests, and test the route as well.
